definitions.explanation: A bridge built of stone. Best known from the proverb {石橋|いしばし}を{叩|たた}いて{渡|わた}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{石橋|いしばし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧。
examples.english: To cross an old stone bridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{石橋|いしばし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{造|つく}られた→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This stone bridge was built in the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{石橋|いしばし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}いて→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: He is the type who taps the stone bridge before crossing it, so every decision takes him a long time.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {石橋|いしばし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}いて→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to tap a stone bridge before crossing it; to be extremely cautious
- {石橋|いしばし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}いて→叩く：02072_tataku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{渡|わた}らない→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: so cautious one never acts at all

The proverb can praise care or gently mock over-caution; the context decides.
